R4B-grouse-drive-0003.name: By Gray Creek
R4B-grouse-drive-0003.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R4B-grouse-drive-0003.parkWhat: pull off on Gray Creek FSR (gravel road)

evidence.t: Road: Gray Creek FSR, 3.1 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
2 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
7 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

flags.t: Route crosses private land (ParcelMap BC, updated 2026-10-01): get permission first or go around.

CWD (Chronic Wasting Disease) Management Zone, MU 4-6: every deer, elk and moose taken here must have its head sampled at a CWD freezer before you leave the zone (www.gov.bc.ca/CWDdropoff). Brain and spinal column (vertebrae, not the tail) may not leave the zone: leave them at the kill site or a landfill in it (synopsis pages 15, 36, 37, 99%).

Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).
Wolf: no closed season in MU 4-6 below 1,100 m (synopsis page 39 footnote, 90%: the Trench line is not mapped and "below 1,100 m" is my reading for both groups). VERIFY with the regional office.

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 4 table (pages 39 and 40), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis). Pages 36 to 41 print no LEH list.
bag 2; private land only, with landowner permission

plan: Drive: from Boswell, about 25 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 3A, Anderson Rd.
Park: 49.62446, -116.73446, pull off on Gray Creek FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the Gray Creek FSR stretch, 3.1 km one way. About 63 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).

Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-6, Region 4. CWD zone: deer, elk and moose heads go to a CWD freezer; brain and spine stay in the zone. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-01, closures 2026-10-16.
R4B-grouse-drive-0003.popWhy: Popular (more hunters): MU 4-6: about 14,152 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 5.97 days per square km, top third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

plan: Drive: from Boswell, about 19 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 3A, Anderson Rd, Gray Creek FSR, Grey Creek Pass FSR.
Park: 49.53266, -116.60301, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 3.7 km SW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 614 m, about 136 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: moose, Sept, Oct (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).

tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).
